label: San Marcos

county_election_office.name: Hays County Elections Office, 120 Stagecoach Trail, San Marcos 78666

zip_caveats: 78666 is mostly Hays County but reaches into Caldwell and Guadalupe counties; voters there get a different county ballot. Texas State students registered at campus addresses vote in Hays County. Congress after the 2025 redraw: San Marcos is in CD-21 (Teixeira vs. Hook); the Labor Council lists Kyle under CD-27. Texas House is HD-45 (Zwiener) or HD-73 (Isaac vs. Fox). State Senate 21 reaches into Hays. HD-45 and HD-73 are not yet in this file; CD-21 has only basic candidate info. San Marcos city races (mayor; council Places 3, 4, 6) and Kyle (mayor; Districts 2 and 4) are nonpartisan. Buda elects an at-large seat and District B.
notes: Hays early voting: Oct 19 to 23 9 AM to 7 PM, Sat Oct 24 7 AM to 7 PM, Sun Oct 25 noon to 6 PM, Oct 26 to 30 7 AM to 7 PM. Main early voting site: Hays County Elections Office, 120 Stagecoach Trail, San Marcos. Any Hays voter can use any Hays vote center. No Hays County, San Marcos CISD or Hays CISD bond or tax measure was confirmed for Nov 2026; the county site blocked automated checks, so verify at the Hays sample ballot.
